## Use When

Use when adding primary or secondary actions in v2 consumers.

## Do

- Use `href` for navigation actions.
- Keep one clear primary action per task.
- Use secondary buttons for cancellation or back navigation.

## Do Not

- Infer v3 action composition from Button usage.
- Turn routine navigation into primary actions everywhere.

## Example

Admin settings can use a primary save button and a secondary cancel link-style button.
